questions.stem: What is meant by a balanced diet?

options.text: A diet that contains only fruits and vegetables
A diet that contains equal amounts of all food groups
A diet that contains all the nutrients in the correct proportions for the body's needs
A diet that provides exactly 2000 calories per day

questions.explanation: A balanced diet contains all the necessary nutrients, including carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, vitamins, minerals, fibre, and water, in the correct proportions to meet the body's needs.
